Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness.
Over nine visits, care consisted of physical therapy, guided home exercise, and short-term anti-inflammatory
medication. The reported symptoms are consistent in nature and location with the mechanism and force of the
impact. Early examinations documented reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion and paraspinal muscle
tenderness, supporting the presenting complaints, while neurological screening and reflex testing remained within
normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body regions is known to this office. The course of care
followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as pain and mobility improved. Billing records reflect
single, appropriate charges for each service rendered without duplication. At the most recent visit the patient reported
substantial improvement and was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
